294:   const parts = path.split(".");
295:   // Try from innermost scope first, then fall back to root
296:   for (let s = 0; s < scopes.length; s++) {
297:     let cur: unknown = scopes[s];
298:     let found = true;
299:     for (let p = 0; p < parts.length; p++) {
300:       if (cur === null || cur === undefined || typeof cur !== "object") {
301:         found = false;
302:         break;
303:       }
304:       cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[parts[p]];
305:       if (cur === undefined) {

307:         break;
308:       }

328:   if (typeof v === "boolean") return String(v);

358:       const v = resolvePath(node.path, scopes);
359:       if (Array.isArray(v)) {

361:           out += renderNodes(node.els, root, scopes);

input.content:
# Mini Template

A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.

## Installation

No dependencies required — just Bun.

## Usage

### CLI

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
```

Reads a UTF-8 template file and a JSON data file, writes the rendered output to stdout.

### API

```ts
import { render } from "./engine";

const output = render("Hello {{name}}!", { name: "World" });
// => "Hello World!"
```

## Syntax

| Syntax | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `{{path}}` | Insert HTML-escaped value |
| `{{{path}}}` | Insert unescaped value |
| `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` | Conditional block (nestable) |
| `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` | Iterate over array (nestable) |
| `{{this}}` | Current item inside `{{#each}}` |
| `{{@index}}` | Zero-based index inside `{{#each}}` |
| `{{! comment }}` | Comment (emits nothing) |

### Escaping

`{{path}}` escapes `& < > " '`:

```ts
render("{{x}}", { x: "<a>&'\"" });
// => "<a>&'""
```

### Truthiness

Empty strings, zero, false, null, undefined, and empty arrays are falsy. All other values are truthy.

### Missing Values

Missing interpolation values render as empty strings.

### Errors

Structural mistakes (unknown block, mismatched/unclosed close, duplicate `else`, `else` outside a block) throw errors with a useful line and column.

## Testing

```sh
bun test
```

238: function resolvePath(path: string, scopes: unknown[]): unknown {
239:   if (path === "this") {
240:     return scopes[0];
241:   }
242:   if (path === "@index") {
243:     return scopes[1];
244:   }
245:   const parts = path.split(".");
246:   if (parts[0] === "this") {
247:     let cur: unknown = scopes[0];
248:     for (let p = 1; p < parts.length; p++) {
249:       if (cur === null || cur === undefined || typeof cur !== "object") return undefined;
250:       cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[parts[p]];
251:       if (cur === undefined) return undefined;
252:     }
253:     return cur;
254:   }
255:   for (let s = 0; s < scopes.length; s++) {
256:     let cur: unknown = scopes[s];
257:     let found = true;
258:     for (let p = 0; p < parts.length; p++) {
259:       if (cur === null || cur === undefined || typeof cur !== "object") {
